answer: A Sybil tax makes bulk forgery pay per head. Every new identity pays a 40 POA entry tax, burned, before it can work; the same tax applies alone or in a rising tide of fakes. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA burned, and sockpuppets piled like a dune lose every tax paid once audit catches them. An honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted.
